name: PointCloud-Text Matching Benchmark
description: A dataset and evaluation suite measuring alignment and retrieval between 3D point clouds and textual descriptions (pointcloud-to-text and text-to-pointcloud matching).
evaluation_method: retrieval metrics (Recall@k, e.g., R@1/R@5/R@10; mean reciprocal rank)
reputation: Newer benchmark for 3D-text alignment and retrieval; of growing interest in 3D multimodal research but not yet widely adopted.
notes: Non-LLM, point-cloud-specific dataset; performance depends heavily on 3D encoding and data augmentation choices; dataset sizes may be limited compared to 2D vision-text benchmarks.
